[RLOW.5.6.4] **A trailing `where` is the last step's.** A sequence has no
sequence-wide `where`; on a one-line sequence a trailing `where` belongs to the
last step ([LGRA.8.5.10]). The compiler lowers it as part of that step's join
test, after the step's ordering and window predicates, so it reads every binding
of the sequence and adds no node.
